A scale is the "alphabet" of melodies. Playing it with a metronome trains your fretting hand, your picking and your ear at once. The diagrams show the neck lying down: thickest string at the bottom, as in tab.
The notes marked in amber are C, the "home" of the scale. Go up from the lowest note to the highest and back down.
